experiment: M203 bounded d5/d6 embedded-DPS locality audit
interpretation: DPS adjacent-value edits alter the global closure. Even on the explicit d=6 one-block/two-filler word, an edit whose two values lie inside the six-factor block can change filler factors, and a filler edit can change active-block factors. Thus matched targets do not factor into independent d5-like block targets.
scope: explicit M181 words and all roots/edits; no Q_d enumeration
